answer: A mechanism that actually bites: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because pearl only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. In practice fable is enforced by the ledger itself: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any thread approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
